title: Prior Authorization Requests, Renewals and Denials for Wound Care Dressings
content:
# Prior authorization — Wound Care Supply Program

Payer relations guidance for the tiers of the Wound Care Supply Program on which the payer requires prior authorization.

## Submitting the request

On tiers where prior authorization is required, Larkfield submits a prior authorization request to the payer once the written order is on file and moves the program from referral received to pending authorization. Each request is based on a written order on file for the item requested.

## Priority and the payer's decision time

A prior authorization request is submitted as expedited only when the prescriber states on the order that waiting the standard decision time could seriously jeopardize the patient's life or health; otherwise it is standard. The payer is expected to decide within the tier's standard decision time, in calendar days, of a standard request, or within the tier's expedited decision time, in hours, of an expedited one.

| What the order states | Priority of the request |
|---|---|
| The prescriber states that waiting the standard decision time could seriously jeopardize the patient's life or health | expedited |
| No such statement | standard |

## The approval

The payer's approval is recorded as an authorization grant with basis payer prior authorization, carrying the payer's PA reference, the approved units and the approved span. The span runs for the tier's prior authorization validity, in calendar months from the decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date, in which case the payer's date governs.

## Renewal

A renewal request for a prior authorization may be submitted no earlier than the tier's renewal lead time, in calendar days, before the valid-through date of the authorization it renews, counted backward in calendar days from that valid-through date with the earliest submission day itself allowed, and it requires a written order that is valid beyond that valid-through date.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical authorization valid through 2026-06-30, renewal lead time of 14 days).* Counting 14 calendar days back from 2026-06-30 gives 2026-06-16.

| Renewal submitted on | Within the renewal lead time |
|---|---|
| 2026-06-16 | Yes — the earliest submission day itself is allowed |
| 2026-06-15 | No — earlier than the earliest submission day |

A renewal submitted on 2026-06-20 also needs a written order whose valid-through date is later than 2026-06-30.

## Denial

A payer denial of a prior authorization is recorded with the payer's denial reason. The program stays in pending authorization while the prescriber supplies further documentation or a new request is made, and it closes only under the administrative closure rules of the Wound Care Supply Program.
